first_chars: After carefully analyzing the three perspectives, I've synthesized the most compelling ideas into a focused set of hypotheses that address the strongest elements from each viewpoint while acknowledging critical concerns and ensuring feasibility.

path: 调研/AutoResearchClaw-Android功耗优化/2026-03-18-03-性能功耗热优化/stage-08/perspectives/contrarian.md
title: Contrarian Analysis: Android 性能功耗热优化研究
first_chars:
## Contrarian Hypothesis 1: The "Security-Performance Tradeoff Fallacy"
### Challenge to Widely-Held Assumption
The mainstream view assumes that security mechanisms (like those studied in Clusters 1, 2, and 4) necessarily degrade Android system performance and increase power consumption. This assumption underpins much of the research gap identified in Gap 2.

path: 调研/AutoResearchClaw-Android功耗优化/2026-03-18-03-性能功耗热优化/stage-08/perspectives/innovator.md
title: Novel Hypotheses for Android Performance, Power, and Thermal Optimization
first_chars:
## Hypothesis 1: Bio-Inspired Thermal Regulation
**Bold Claim**: Android devices can achieve optimal thermal management by mimicking biological thermoregulation systems, creating a "living" OS that adapts its thermal behavior like a biological organism rather than using static threshold-based cooling.

path: 调研/AutoResearchClaw-Android功耗优化/2026-03-18-03-性能功耗热优化/stage-08/perspectives/pragmatist.md
title: Hypotheses for Android Performance, Power, and Thermal Optimization
first_chars:
## Hypothesis 1: Lightweight On-Device Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Thermal Management
**Concrete Claim**: A lightweight reinforcement learning (RL) agent deployed directly on Android devices can optimize thermal management by dynamically adjusting CPU frequencies and thermal thresholds, reducing device temperature by at least 15% while maintaining within 5% of original performance levels.
